signal: A failing --preflight invocation overwrites an existing proof-output/cloud-paper/status.json with FAIL_CLOSED even though preflight is specified as read-only.
root_cause: The __main__ exception handler unconditionally writes FAIL_CLOSED status for both --preflight and --once.
upstream_downstream: A cloud workflow or operator running configuration-only preflight with missing credentials/invalid PAPER flags can mutate the previous PAPER cycle's status, making evidence refer to a non-execution. A success preflight already preserved status.
severity: P1 evidence-status provenance integrity; reproduced only in isolated offline subprocesses, not an observed cloud production failure.
prevention_hypothesis: Restrict CLI exception-path status writes to the exact --once invocation; failed and successful --preflight must preserve prior status bytes, while failed --once still fails closed.

baseline.raw_pytest: 2 failed, 379 passed, 3 skipped, 3 warnings, 68 subtests passed
reproduced_cases: preflight with invalid PAPER_MODE overwrites prior status
preflight with missing credentials overwrites prior status

repair.description: Only exact CLI --once failure owns FAIL_CLOSED status writes; --preflight exceptions exit nonzero without modifying proof status.
repair.rollback: Governed revert on owned draft branch after preserving test evidence; never force push.

regression.mode: Offline subprocess using temporary copies of runner modules, dummy environment values, no network, broker, cloud or orders

after_ci.qualifier: Not full mandatory-gate PASS: BigQuery, Colab contract and Windows-only tests skipped

next_session_recurrence_check: Re-run exact deployed SHA in an authorized cloud PAPER environment. Confirm --preflight failure does not mutate previous run status and --once failure publishes FAIL_CLOSED with independent artifact/run correlation.
reopen_if: Any --preflight success or failure modifies proof status
Any --once exception leaves a previous success as current
A preflight status is presented as a verified PAPER execution
